nodes.label: Trained Model Performance Worse Than Base Model
RAFT Vision Training methodology: teach models to prioritize oracle context/images and ignore distractors

Modelfile (prompt customization) vs Full Fine-Tuning: Modelfile is fast/minutes and only customizes the system prompt without touching weights; full fine-tuning changes weights, needs 200+ examples and 24+GB VRAM for deeper domain adaptation
Oracle/Distractor annotation methodology: mark relevant text/images as oracle and irrelevant/noise context as distractor so the model learns to focus on relevant information
Curriculum learning: progressive phased training (foundation to intermediate to advanced) for better results
Active learning loop: prioritize annotation effort on examples where the model is most uncertain for more efficient model improvement
